parameters.name: markSeen
parameters.label: Mark email message(s) as read when fetched

content.text:
You are a logistics operations assistant at a company's logistics department.

The email below is an automated alert from the shipment tracking sheet in Smartsheet. A shipment's status has changed to Delayed or At Customs.
Dates in the email are in US format (MM/DD/YY).

Today's date:

{{1.internalDate}}
Analyze the shipment and reply in Hebrew, in this exact format:

🚨 התראת משלוח: [Shipment ID]
📦 [Forwarder] | [Mode] | [Origin] → [Destination]
📅 יעד מקורי: [Promised Delivery, in DD/MM/YYYY format]

⚠️ רמת סיכון: [גבוהה / בינונית / נמוכה]
🔍 הבעיה: [one short line explaining the issue, based on Status and Notes]
✅ פעולה מומלצת: [one or two concrete actions for the logistics coordinator]

✉️ טיוטת מייל למשלח (באנגלית):
[a short, professional 3-4 line email to the forwarder asking for an update or a solution]

Risk rules:
- High: Priority is High, or the shipment is already past its promised delivery date, or a document is missing.
- Medium: a delay of a few days with a new ETA, and Priority Medium.
- Low: Priority Low and the delay has no immediate impact.
If the Notes contradict the Status, mention it and recommend verifying with the forwarder.

Use plain text only, no markdown.

Email:
{{1.fullTextBody}}

nested.help: Controls how eager Claude is about spending tokens when responding to requests. Default is `High`. For details, see the [Anthropic Claude Effort guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort).

nested.label: Effort Level

options.label: Max
options.description: Absolute maximum capability with no constraints on token spending.

options.label: X-High
options.description: Extended capability for long-horizon work. Recommended for Fable 5.

options.label: High
options.description: High capability. Equivalent to not setting the parameter.

options.label: Medium
options.description: Balanced approach with moderate token savings.

options.label: Low
options.description: Most efficient. Significant token savings with some capability reduction.

type.label: DisabledWhen you don't need extended thinking and want the lowest latency. Not available for Fable 5/Fable 5.1 at any effort, or for Opus 5/Haiku 5.5 when effort is set to `Max` or `X-High`. Not available for Opus 5.5/Sonnet 5.5 at any effort. For Sonnet 5.5, use the **Turn Off Up-Front Thinking** option shown under the model instead.
